answers.core: It improves UX and opens wide 3D creation out of the box, and it would be to tied to the core for being an addon I think
answers.workaround: There is maybe a way of doing that via Gizmo plugins, but at this state the docs are quite confusing and the whole thing would be sooo difficult to setup for just a "small" feature. If it's out of the box, is something everyone could take advantage.
